derivation: Layout [burstID:8][seq:u16be][flags:u8][payload] transcribed from VoiceBurstPacket.encode; the field values are the VoiceBurstPacketTests fixtures (burstID = bytes 0x01..0x08). The six reject cases are verbatim byte literals from rejectsMalformedInput.

vectors.name: start_aac_lc_16k_mono
vectors.note: VoiceBurstPacketTests.startRoundTrip fixture. START is flags 0x01 with a single codec byte.

vectors.name: frames_two
vectors.note: VoiceBurstPacketTests.framesRoundTrip fixture. Data packets are flags 0x00 followed by repeated [len:u16be][frame].

decode_rejects.name: ten_zero_bytes
decode_rejects.note: One byte short of the header. Literal from VoiceBurstPacketTests.rejectsMalformedInput.

decode_rejects.name: unknown_flags
decode_rejects.note: Literal from the same test: flags 0xFF is not a known kind.

decode_rejects.name: data_packet_with_zero_frames
decode_rejects.note: Literal: a data packet must carry at least one frame.

decode_rejects.name: truncated_frame_length
decode_rejects.note: Literal: frame declares 16 bytes, one follows.
